messages.subject: Re: will get the data from db to shiny?
parts:
1) This line:
  qry <- "select SECURITYKEY from usersessiontracking where User_Name = '" + username + "'"
should be replaced with this:
  qry <- "select SECURITYKEY from usersessiontracking where User_Name = '" + dbEscapeStrings(con, username) + "'"
Otherwise, it would be easy for an attacker to type in their name as foo';DROP DATABASE srinergi_sales;-- and you would lose your whole database. This is called SQL injection and you must give careful thought to avoiding it whenever you put database-accessing apps in users' hands.

2) In the future I highly recommend you NOT posting a real username/password to a public forum or mailing list!!

3) You are calling dbDisconnect before you actually fetch your data. I'd recommend taking out that dbDisconnect call, and instead, immediately after the line with dbConnect, add the line:
on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
This way, it will properly close the connection even if an exception occurs.
